To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Wikipedia can be used as a global “real-time knowledge base” for social media, and that entity extraction, linking, classification, and tagging for social media can be solved with an end-to-end system that is synergistic, scalable, and effective.
Wikipedia is well suited for processing social data, and that we can achieve high accuracy by interweaving the tasks in a global knowledge base and using social signals.

(1) a Wikipedia-based global knowledge base is a good fit for social data; (2) the tasks can be interwoven in a synergistic manner to improve performance; (3) the system can be scaled to the entire Twitter stream using a variety of techniques; and (4) the system can produce high quality results that are suitable for a wide range of applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing an end-to-end entity extraction, linking, classification, and tagging system for social media that can scale to the entire Twitter stream and that is tailored for social media, and with describing the system in depth and showing its effectiveness.
the development of scalable systems that extract entities from social text data, link them to entities of interest, classify and tag them, and use them for a variety of applications.
building and deploying a complete end-to-end industrial solution for entity extraction, linking, classification, and tagging for social media.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system is a scalable industrial solution that can solve these tasks for social data, that is well suited to social data, and that outperforms current systems.

we have developed a system that can extract entities and classify and tag them in a synergistic manner, using a Wikipedia-based knowledge base and a variety of social signals, that outperforms current systems, and that is scalable to the entire Twitter Firehose.
we have built a state-of-the-art system to extract entities from tweets, link them to entities from Wikipedia, classify tweets, and assign descriptive labels to tweets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created a scalable, industrial-strength solution to extract, link, classify, and tag entities in social data, which can be used to build many applications.
we show how a system built around a global knowledge base can provide a scalable, robust, and accurate solution for the entity extraction, linking, classification, and tagging tasks.
we have developed and deployed a complete system that is able to extract, link, classify, and tag social data, and that we have learned a lot in the process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build industrial-scale systems to solve these problems.
a Wikipedia-based knowledge base is a powerful and practical approach to solve entity extraction, linking, and classification/tagging problems for social data.
a Wikipedia-based knowledge base is well suited for extracting, linking, classifying, and tagging social data, and that the tasks can be solved in a synergistic manner.
